About Us:
Join our dynamic team at Royal Papua Yacht Club, where we are committed to promoting health and wellness. We provide a welcoming environment for members to achieve their fitness goals and are looking for a friendly and motivated Gym Attendant to enhance our team.
Job Description:
As a Gym Attendant, you will be the first point of contact for our members, ensuring a safe, clean, and enjoyable environment. Your role is vital in delivering excellent customer service, maintaining gym facilities, and assisting members with their needs.
Responsibilities:
Greet and assist members in a friendly manner
Maintain cleanliness and hygiene of all gym areas and equipment
Monitor gym activities to ensure safety and enforce gym policies
Provide guidance on the proper use of equipment
Handle member inquiries and resolve issues promptly
Assist in organizing gym programs and activities
Report any maintenance or safety concerns to management
Requirements:
Previous experience in a customer service or fitness environment is a plus
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Friendly, approachable, and professional demeanour
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends
Knowledge of gym equipment and safety protocols is preferred
